The downside of Divine Chaos is
1. It costs a ton more Keyflare to Posse
2. You cannot use your selected Posse so characters that want a **specific Posse* to be used every turn, gets gutted by this. Kath and Cantena are two examples.
3. You can only use your selected Posse on Rouse activation.
4. Mono Chaos hates Divine Chaos because you lose alot of the benefits of Mono Chaos. Such as Double Posse every turn, Keyflare at EOT, Aliemus on Exalting. Alot of Mono Chaos teams want these benefits to scale and spam.

Those are **downsides** and I didnt mention upsides so its skewed.

Specifically, Oathbound, he makes you draw less from his stacking mechanic and alot of characters hate that. Kath, Cetarchon.
